aftershock_hazard_clustering.forced_precedence: legacy singular first, ordered forced_shocks list after it, last write wins; forced aftershock severity contributes to the next two days

depot_damage.replacement_rule: stronger penalty or longer remaining duration wins

inter_depot_transfer.selection: most starved receiver, then largest eligible surplus donor, ties by service order

objective.allocation_variable: x, the five projected daily allocations
objective.description: maximize current-day priority-weighted feasible repair supply under the identical v2 state, logistics ledger, daily bounds, and full-allocation equality
objective.objective: maximize sum(priority * service_deficit * (eta * support + 0.04 * dependency_centrality) * effective_throughput * y)
objective.repair_dispatch_variable: y, the five pre-throughput repair dispatches

coefficient_freeze.rule: Any coefficient or protocol change invalidates all v2 training, parity, and held-out evidence and requires a new protocol version plus a complete rerun.

uncertainty.method: paired deterministic nonparametric bootstrap over complete scenario-seed units

metric_definitions.food_spoilage_units: sum of the food component of the serialized daily spoilage vector
metric_definitions.inter_depot_transfer_units: sum of positive components of the zero-sum daily mutual-aid transfer vector
metric_definitions.mean_depot_stock_fraction: arithmetic mean of all five end-of-day stock/capacity fractions over the complete trajectory
metric_definitions.queued_delivery_unit_days: sum of the five end-of-day next-day delivery queue values over the complete trajectory
metric_definitions.throughput_constrained_unit_days: sum over services and days of pre-throughput repair dispatch minus actual throughput-scaled repair supply

logistics_ledger_equalities: depot_stock_end = depot_stock_before + pending_arrivals_landed + mutual_aid_net + same_day_delivery_landed - repair_supply - spoilage
depot_stock_before + pending_arrivals + projected_allocation + mutual_aid_net - repair_supply - spoilage - depot_stock_end - pending_next_day = 0
outcome_rule: Report the measured v2 candidate-minus-baseline results for every registered metric. Call the primary result an improvement only when mean candidate resilience AUC is higher; otherwise report the measured resilience, recovery, and logistics trade-off without changing the candidate, baseline, holdout, coefficients, or metric set.
split_unit: complete authored scenario-family member plus seed
synthetic_disclosure: structurally realistic, authored-synthetic, not empirically calibrated to real disasters

transition_equations.depot_stock_ready: depot_stock_after_pending + mutual_aid_net; evaluated before same-day allocation x lands
transition_equations.v1_relationship: eta, delta, dependency support, resilience, and reward coefficients are unchanged; v2 uses repair dispatch and throughput in gain and substitutes actual repair_supply for allocation in strain

transition_order.1: land prior-day pending freight at capacity, recording pending_arrivals_landed and pending_arrivals_held separately
transition_order.2: apply the typed service and depot shock, update damage duration, and compute support, road capacity, and throughput
transition_order.3: execute at most one deterministic inter-depot transfer
transition_order.4: project the full available budget to allocation x; split 0.65*x into same_day_delivery_landed and same_day_delivery_held, schedule 0.35*x as delayed delivery, and carry every held unit into pending_next_day
transition_order.5: compute reserve draw, pre-throughput repair dispatch y, actual repair_supply=y*throughput, gain=eta*sqrt(y/200)*support*throughput*(1-service_after_shock), and strain using repair_supply
transition_order.6: apply 0.006 food-stock spoilage and no spoilage to the other four stocks
transition_order.7: serialize the complete deterministic allocation, service, stock, queue, damage, throughput, transfer, overflow, draw, and spoilage ledger
